name: INA240
description: TI INA240 -4V to 80V bidirectional current-sense amplifier -- candidate current-sense part for the power stage, paired with the WSLP2512 shunt (TODO.md 5.3).
verification: VERIFIED -- full 8-pin map read directly from the local copy of [22] (TI SBOS662C, 'Revised December 2021'), Sec. 6 'Pin Configuration and Functions', Table 6-1 'Pin Functions', Figure 6-2 'D Package 8-Pin SOIC Top View'. This spec uses the D (SOIC-8) package pinout. The PW (TSSOP-8) package variant uses a DIFFERENT pin numbering for the same signals -- 1 NC, 2 IN+, 3 IN-, 4 GND, 5 VS, 6 REF2, 7 REF1, 8 OUT (Figure 6-1) -- if TSSOP is selected instead, regenerate against that map, not this one. Device also confirmed: gains fixed per part suffix (INA240A1=20V/V, A2=50V/V, A3=100V/V, A4=200V/V, Sec. 5 Table 5-1); supply 2.7-5.5V, 2.4mA max; common-mode -4V to +80V.
